title: Rename a Claude session from the Claude pane
notes: Claude Code: /rename names the session, shown on the prompt bar. SDK: renameSession (sdk.d.ts:3347). Pane: /resume shows only the summary (chat-commands.ts:70). Size S.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #122: /rename names the conversation and /resume lists it by that name; with no name or no conversation yet, it is refused.
